description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District (25/0100)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land parcel information. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
